title: The Structure of Almost Stationary Measures
summary: Let $G$ be a higher-rank simple Lie group acting on a space $X$. A theorem of Nevo and Zimmer asserts that every ergodic stationary probability measure on $X$ is either $G$-invariant or admits a projective factor $G/Q$ for a proper parabolic subgroup $Q$. We develop a quantitative theory of stationary measures and prove an effective form of this dichotomy. We introduce notions of $\eps$-almost stationarity, $δ$-almost invariance and $δ$-almost projective factor, and show that every $\eps$-almost stationary measure is either $δ$-almost invariant or carries a $δ'$-almost projective factor,…
